jamie-sre: Quick check-in after postmortem. We keep hitting latency spikes when large embedding batches show up. Need owners for short-term mitigations + SLO tweaks and dashboard updates.
kira-ml: I can own routing/fallback logic. Short-term: detect heavy-batch header and steer to autoscaled pool; medium-term: tenant throttles.
patrick-oncall: I'll take the runbook + failover test. Plan: add a new alert for embedding-batch burn-rate and a documented manual throttle step. Will test in staging.
marta-engplatform: Ill own dashboards. Proposed panels: p50/p95/p99 by model_variant, QPS by tenant, and a rolling burn-rate gauge. Need exact query from telemetry.
rory-telemetry: Dropping a query sketch and will add incident markers. Also will add a weekly regression that replays a small embedding workload to spot recurrences.
````
select
  tenant_id,
  model_variant,
  quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) as p95,
  quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) as p99,
  count() as qps
from requests
where env='prod' and request_type='embedding' and time > now() - 1h
group by tenant_id, model_variant
````

jamie-sre: Proposal for SLO changes: add a throughput SLO for heavy-batch embedding endpoints (advertised as sustained QPS per-tenant) and tighten hosted p95 from 320ms -> 300ms but only after we verify dashboard signals for 7 days. Thoughts?
kira-ml: Prefer staged approach: keep p95 at 320ms for shared-hosted, introduce a "batch throughput" SLO: sustained average per-tenant QPS < T (T TBD). We can recommend Dedicated customers to get stricter p95.
marta-engplatform: I'll draft a dashboard-driven gating rule: only apply stricter SLO after 7-day rolling window of no burn-rate > 1.5. That avoids flip-flopping.
patrick-oncall: Runbook acceptance: playbook updated + staging failover test documented + one successful test with simulated embedding burst. Target: prototype in 5 business days.
rory-telemetry: Dashboard acceptance: panels live in grafana, synthetic alert tests pass in staging, incident marker examples attached to ticket.
infra-bot: ticket #RWD-4488 created: "Embedding burst mitigation - SLO & dashboards" assigned to jamie-sre, due 2026-04-20. Link: https://tickets.example/RWD-4488
